goal: Implement the advisory AI Code Improvement feature for assigned Developer reports.
decisions: Reuse the existing server-only AI gateway and ai_usage accounting; do not add persistence for review results.
Return a bounded JSON review and reject malformed provider output rather than displaying arbitrary provider text.
Reject oversized code or supporting context before provider use; do not silently truncate the improvement request.
Keep the feature advisory-only with no execution, revision, note, assignment, or lifecycle mutation.
findings: The first coordination context pack exceeded the configured 240-line budget; it was narrowed to 200 lines before claiming the task.
The build passed with an existing warning about dynamic filesystem tracing in python-validation.ts; this feature does not introduce that warning.
acceptance_criteria: Only an authenticated assigned Developer can request the review.
Suggestions include category, rationale, benefit, and trade-off fields.
Generated code remains inert suggested text and cannot be applied automatically.
Security and malformed-provider cases are covered by focused tests.
verification: Focused Vitest run: 5 files passed, 18 tests passed after the final redaction change.
npm run build passed with one pre-existing tracing warning.
remaining_work: Run the database test command in an environment where the local Supabase CLI can write telemetry.
Complete final security and verification review records, then release the workflow claim.
